_comments: Which SECTION of the generated Contract Type form ContractType.Code appears in: with Name and
Status under 'Contract Type Details'. Stated here for the same reason as
.default-contract-terms-category.json: CodeGen's AI categorisation does not reliably assign a
Category to a new field, and an uncategorised field renders in a generic Details block.
ExtendedType and CodeType are cleared on purpose. CodeGen's AI pass reads the field name 'Code'
as source code and sets ExtendedType = 'Code', which renders a short UPPER_SNAKE identifier in
a code editor. It is a plain text field.
